description: The engine repo's own dependencies: GitHub Actions, pinned by commit SHA with a version comment, the example toolchain (examples/mise/config.toml), the Linux test images (test/containers/matrix.json, parity 0.9), and the dev-only type definitions in tools/types/package.json (@types/node, D45), under the same rules users get (renovate/steward.json). package.json has no dependencies. A config repo extends renovate/steward.json at a release tag instead of this file. (In a checkout that is also an instance, the root renovate.json wins and this file is not read.)

packageRules.description: Actions: one PR per action, after the same 3-day gate; a digest-only update rides with the version it belongs to
Linux test images: digest updates only, within the tag (a new distribution release is added deliberately, per D-c)

customManagers.description: The Linux test images in test/containers/matrix.json: each is pinned by tag and digest; a new digest (or tag) waits out the same 3-day gate (parity 0.9)
